create_adaptive_router_update_queue: create an in-memory queue for aggregating adaptive router state and session updates
add_state_delta: add a bandit-cell delta to the state aggregator by router name, request type, and model name
add_session_state: add a session snapshot to the session aggregator with last-write-wins semantics per session and model
flush_state_to_db: flush aggregated state deltas to the database using atomic upsert with Prisma client
flush_session_to_db: flush aggregated session snapshots to the database using atomic upsert with Prisma client
